recommendation_summary: The reply recommends keeping the job on edna and having it send a success/failure heartbeat to a monitor running in Docker on the Synology, which alerts the user if no success arrives by 04:30.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked to catch a 4-day silent failure on edna, and suggested a central log on Synology in Docker.
labels.Deleted: Central log and moving everything to Docker; a central log you never read fails the same way.
labels.Bottleneck: No signal when the job dies before email, not where logs live.
labels.Checked myself: Nothing checked, from your description only.

note: It is one heartbeat alert, but it counts as LARGER because it is a self-hosted monitor in Docker on the Synology, which is part of the user's framed stack.
